Description:
Add a touch of vintage industrial charm to your home or collection with this bundle of 3 glass insulators. Featuring distinct shades of aqua and teal, these insulators showcase classic ridged forms and subtle unique bubbles trapped within the glass, hinting at their history and craftsmanship. Each piece has embossed marks, such as 'MADE IN U.S.A.', reflecting authentic American manufacturing origins. Perfect as decorative accent pieces for shelves, table centerpieces, or repurposed as creative home projects, these insulators blend functional design with nostalgic appeal. The set includes two larger pieces and one slightly smaller, all in varying tones that catch and scatter light beautifully. Their substantial weight and thick glass construction ensure lasting durability, while the visible wear and minor scuffs add character that appeals to collectors and lovers of vintage decor. A smart choice for those seeking authentic, visually-striking accent objects that celebrate industrial heritage. These insulators are in used condition with signs of previous use visible

281230869.description:
Lionel Postwar O Gauge Flatcar Lot - 2 Pieces With Original Boxes
No. 6801 Flatcar with Boat & No. 6477 Bulkhead Flatcar with Pipe Load
Postwar Era, Made in USA
This vintage lot features two classic Postwar Lionel O gauge freight cars accompanied by their original boxes. Included are the No. 6801 flatcar equipped with its white cradle and blue-and-white plastic cabin cruiser boat, along with the No. 6477 bulkhead flatcar carrying a structural pipe load secured between side stakes. Produced during the late 1950s, these workhorse freight cars showcase the ingenuity and charm of Lionel's golden era of model railroading.
Lionel No. 6801 red flatcar with white cradle and blue/white runabout boat marked 6801-50
Lionel No. 6477 red bulkhead flatcar with black end racks, vertical side stakes, and pipe load
Both cars feature operational knuckle couplers and die-cast metal trucks
Includes two original Lionel Corporation classic orange-and-blue illustrated boxes
Condition:
Flatcars display light play wear consistent with age, including faint surface scuffs and light oxidation on metal axles and couplers. The boat shows mild dust accumulation and age-related toning to the cream plastic deck. Pipe load exhibits minor surface marks. Both boxes have shelf wear, edge creasing, and flap wear, with one box missing end flaps. Complete as pictured.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland

The second specimen is a dark brown, irregular rock containing plant and leaf fossils with black impressions and some surface cracking. Both fossils are in natural condition, suitable for collectors or educational use. Measures approx. 5.5" x 4" and 5.5" x 4.5" and the total weight is approximately 646 grams.

280720153.description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot - 21 Pieces
Mixed Mineral Collection
Various Colors, Modern Era
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of natural mineral specimens, showcasing a variety of crystal habits, colors, and geological formations. The lot includes popular collector staples like deep purple amethyst druzy and iridescent bismuth, making it an excellent starter set for geological study or decorative display.
Pieces Included:
Amethyst - 5 specimens including two large druzy clusters and three points/raw pieces
Selenite - 3 specimens including two towers (satin spar) and one rectangular bar
Pyrite - 3 raw "fool's gold" metallic specimens
Bismuth - 2 lab-grown iridescent hopper crystal specimens
Rose Quartz - 2 raw pink quartz chunks
Celestite - 1 large pale blue crystalline cluster
Desert Rose - 1 gypsum rosette specimen
Labradorite - 1 polished slab showing blue/green labradorescence
Additional specimens include yellow calcite, green aventurine, and clear quartz points
Condition:
The collection is in excellent condition as natural specimens. All crystalline structures appear well-preserved with no significant post-extraction damage. The total weight of the collection is 3.245 lbs as shown in scale photography.
